chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

Allah, majestic is His glory, said: ‘My servants, all of you are misguided except those whom I have guided; all of you are poor except those whom I have enriched; and all of you are sinners except those whom I have protected.’

key_terms.ضَالٌّ: misguided; lacking right guidance without divine direction
key_terms.عَصَمْتُهُ: I have protected him; preserved from falling into sin
key_terms.عِبَادِي: My servants; Allah’s address to all human beings as His servants
key_terms.فَقِيرٌ: poor and in need; utterly dependent upon Allah
key_terms.مُذْنِبٌ: sinful; one who falls into sin

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe humanity’s dependence on Allah for guidance, sustenance, and protection from sin?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the absolute dependence of all human beings upon Allah for guidance, provision, and protection from sin. It expresses core theological truths about human neediness and Allah’s exclusive lordship, grace, and safeguarding care.
